text:
maria_support: FYI customer (tenant acme-corp) just flagged that after our retention policy change last night a subset of logs that should have been preserved for 90d were purged. legal is asking for an immediate preservation / snapshot :eyes:
ajay_cse: Customer claims they had a custom 90-day policy on their account, not the 30d default. Can we confirm the active policy for tenant acme-corp?
sierra_security: tagging in — we need to know whether a legal hold was applied before the purge started. If not, advise legal steps. :lock:
maria_support: I ran the control-plane query and saw a mismatch: control plane returns retention: 90d, but the private-deploy agent responded with retention: 30d for several nodes. Repro steps below:
```
# control plane
GET /v1/tenants/acme-corp/retention -> {"policy":"90d","applied_at":"2025-09-12T01:00:00Z"}
# private agent
ssh deploy@acme-node-3 "/opt/redwood/bin/retentionctl status" -> retention=30d
```
tom_infra: that suggests config sync failed during the config push that happened at 00:50. I see a partial rollout and one node timed out when fetching KMS creds. Investigating network logs.
ajay_cse: Customer reports an API error when they attempted to set the hold yesterday: 403 without detailed message. They can provide request id if needed.
sierra_security: 403 could indicate the key wrap permission failed on the HSM side during the hold creation. Please grab the audit log entries for the tenant around 2025-09-12T00:45-01:05.
maria_support: retention-bot just returned the relevant audit slice but entries show multiple KMS:decrypt failures: `error=KMSError(key-unavailable)`. Snippet:
```
[2025-09-12T00:51:12Z] tenant=acme-corp action=apply_hold user=legal@acme err=KMSError(key-unavailable) request_id=rq_0a1b2c
[2025-09-12T00:52:03Z] tenant=acme-corp action=policy_sync node=acme-node-3 err=timeout request_id=rq_0a1b3d
```
legal-team: we need a formal hold timeline and a guarantee to stop further deletions immediately. Can ops snapshot the retention state and provide export for legal review? :exclamation:
tom_infra: can create snapshot of index and object metadata for tenant. Will need to escalate to on-call infra and request KMS support. ETA ~25 min.
ajay_cse: Customer is asking for rollback or immediate recovery of purged objects — do we have a soft-delete tombstone window or backups?
sierra_security: If objects are fully garbage-collected beyond tombstone, recovery may be very difficult. First step: freeze deletion queue for tenant and preserve current storage shards. Then provide legal with MD5 list and deletion timestamps.
maria_support: freezing deletion queue now requested. Applied hold command to orchestrator: `POST /internal/ops/freeze-delete?tenant=acme-corp` -> 202 Accepted.
retention-bot: OPERATION: freeze-delete accepted for tenant=acme-corp by user=maria_support at 2025-09-12T00:58:20Z.
tom_infra: I've opened an auth ticket to KMS team referencing rq_0a1b2c and rq_0a1b3d. KMS team response: key rotation in progress overlapped with policy push, temporary unavailability on node 3.
ajay_cse: Customer sent the 403 request_id: rq_0a1b2c and a stack trace showing `apply_hold -> kms.wrapKey -> 403`. Forwarding to infra + security.
sierra_security: Good. Next steps: (1) provide legal with ordered audit export (2) confirm which objects were deleted vs tombstoned (3) KMS to confirm if wrapped keys were lost or just delayed (4) ops to snapshot shards for forensics.
maria_support: compiling export now — pulling audit logs, object metadata, and policy history. Will attach to the ticket.
legal-team: please include timestamps in UTC and make sure PII redaction is applied except for identifiers we need. We may need a hold letter to the customer depending on scope.
retention-bot: AUDIT_EXPORT_READY tenant=acme-corp size=6.2MB path=/internal/exports/acme-20250912-audit.json.gz
tom_infra: snapshot of object metadata completed for shards s-12,s-14,s-19. Creating a tarball and moving to secure bucket.
ajay_cse: Customer now asking whether this affects billing or retention SLA. We should include SLA impact and whether any credits are warranted.
sierra_security: Hold off on credits until root cause confirmed. Prioritize containment and forensic detail.
maria_support: I'll post a status update to the customer in 30 minutes and share the audit export and next steps. tagging @legal-team and @sierra_security for final review before send.
legal-team: ack, we'll review and advise on preservation letter wording.
sierra_security: once KMS confirms, we'll coordinate mitigation: rewrap keys, re-sync policy, and run integrity scan for any unencrypted tombstones.
ajay_cse: thanks all — customer asked for a single point of contact. I'll act as liaison. Please DM me any sensitive artifacts. :white_check_mark:
